label: Straight
note: Owner-uploaded reference images. Authoritative for construction/appearance; NOT usable as the tech-pack illustration (not line art, or shows multiple options).

references.evidence: Measured on a 3x crop, the four buttonhole eyes lie on a row running at about -39 degrees while each buttonhole slit runs at about +44 to +49 degrees — every slit is square (perpendicular) to the line of buttons, i.e. the traditional straight/horizontal orientation across the sleeve, with no cant. All four slits are parallel to one another and the count (4) is a standard cuff run. Real cloth with visible weave, thread fibres and specular highlights: a photograph.
